gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.167: As the werewolf's beast, right-click a body or a severed limb to tear into it. Every bite feeds you and closes your wounds. Sneak and right-click to carry it instead.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.168: Leave a severed limb lying and it won't stay there long. Wolves, bears and big cats eat it where it lies, and a vulture will snatch it up and fly off with it.
